note: Superior National Forest (Gunflint district) campground on 643-acre East Bearskin Lake, about 26 miles up the Gunflint Trail from Grand Marais. Wooded loops under pine, fir and birch; only a few sites see the water. Boat ramp at the campground; the lake's two eastern bays lie inside the Boundary Waters (day permits at the campground) with a portage to Flour Lake. Bearskin Lodge next door rents boats and sells supplies. Four camper cabins. --Claude
